# Realtime Engineering

Trace both browser client and server. Verify endpoint/token issuance, origin/configuration, connection lifecycle, authentication, subscriptions, routing, serialization, acknowledgements, reconnect, duplicate delivery, and cleanup.

Never weaken authentication to make a socket connect. Test connection failure and recovery, not only the happy path. Coordinate with Frontend and Backend when client/server contracts change.
